about: Battersea Bright Cleaning is a local, fully insured cleaning team covering Wandsworth, Battersea and Clapham. Every cleaner is reference-checked, trained on our room-by-room checklists, and brings eco-friendly supplies on request — with clear fixed prices and zero agency admin fees.
